source: ability-icons commit 0d0555a (art/mechanic-icons-20261022), approved by Chzy18 2026-10-23; ids, names, tags and shapes from docs/boss-attack-icons/<boss>/manifest.json; this copy carries the Aurelion attacks (5 approved 2026-10-23; errant_planets, falling_meridians and sunspots added 2026-11-07 from Codex work/attack-icons-20261106) plus Codex's 11 Sylvara v3 icons (work/attack-icons-20261102), approved by Chzy18 2026-11-02; icon bullet counts are approximate, so always show the name with the icon (Crucivar icons stay local until that boss ships; normal Bellkeeper v2 is retired)

attacks.name: Meridian Lances
attacks.shape: Three or four full-arena crossing beams, 2.2 m wide.

attacks.name: Starfall Mirror
attacks.shape: Player-centred circles plus reflections through arena centre; r 2.2 (1.8 at N≥5).

attacks.name: Noon Shadow
attacks.shape: Half-arena cleave split by a straight line through arena centre.

attacks.name: Orrery Closing
attacks.shape: Outer rim annulus r≥8.5 plus filled crown circle r3.6 at boss; safe band between.

attacks.name: Hour Hands
attacks.shape: Boss-to-rim radial lane spokes through player hours, 1.8 m wide; Hard only.

attacks.name: Errant Planets
attacks.shape: Planets of r 0.8 circling the arena on fixed orbits (Phase 2; Hard: one on the 12 m rim in Phase 1); 30 once per lap.

attacks.name: Falling Meridians
attacks.shape: A 2.5 m circle at each standing player's feet every 3.5 s in Phase 3; Hard adds an echo 0.6 s later.

attacks.name: Sunspots
attacks.shape: Sigils on carriers detonate in turn (3.5 m blast) and leave 3.0 m burning scorch pools; a blast that catches another carrier is a Solar Flare.

attacks.name: Spiral Bloom
attacks.shape: Petal bullets spiralling out from Sylvara in 3-6 arms; a toll can reverse the spin.

attacks.name: Seed Pods
attacks.shape: A pod lands on a circle on the farthest players (or her feet) and bursts into a ring of petals.

attacks.name: Waterfall Jets
attacks.shape: Water drops pour in from the wall along a 40-degree wedge that sweeps sideways.

attacks.name: Pruning Arc
attacks.shape: Front and back 120-degree cones from Sylvara, then a fan of petals; the sides are safe.

attacks.name: Two-Colour Choir
attacks.shape: Brass and cobalt spirals and lanes: only petals of your own colour hurt you.

attacks.name: Toll Burst
attacks.shape: A ring of 20 alternating brass and cobalt petals as the toll swaps every colour.

attacks.name: Root Ring
attacks.shape: A filled circle of roots around Sylvara that erupts after 2 s.

attacks.name: Hollow Bloom
attacks.shape: Each Choir Bud fires a 3-arm petal spiral until it is cut.

attacks.name: Bud Bloom
attacks.shape: An uncut Choir Bud blooms into a ring of 20 petals.

attacks.name: Seed Storm
attacks.shape: Big seeds drift out and burst into 8 petals (10 on Hard).

attacks.name: Last Storm
attacks.shape: The enrage at 2:00 into Phase 4: a dense spiral and constant seed rings.
